People for Palmer Park Thursday Ride

Detroit, MI · Palmer Park · Social · Road

People for Palmer Park Thursday Ride is a social and road group ride in Detroit, MI. It rolls every Thursday at 6:30 pm from Palmer Park Community House lot. Pace: fitness pace, 10–15 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 10–15 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills.
Check
Look at @pfpalmerpark the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the People for Palmer Park Thursday Ride group ride

A one-hour loop out of Palmer Park through the Apartment District, Golf Club neighborhood, Ferndale, New Center and Boston Edison. Led by a park volunteer. Join for part or all of it.
